title: Configure Centralized Remote Syslog Logging with High Precision Timestamps
description: Network devices must send all security, authentication, and administrative event logs to a centralized remote SIEM / Syslog host with millisecond timestamp precision.
rationale: Local device buffers can be easily overwritten or tampered with by an attacker. Remote logging preserves forensic integrity during incident response.
failure_message: Centralized remote syslog host is not configured or log timestamp precision is inadequate.

title: Configure Authenticated Network Time Protocol (NTP) Synchronization
description: Network devices must synchronize system clocks using at least two authoritative NTP servers with cryptographic authentication enabled.
rationale: Accurate and tamper-resistant timestamps across all network infrastructure are critical for distributed event correlation, forensic analysis, and certificate validity.
failure_message: NTP time synchronization servers are not configured.
warning_message: NTP is configured but cryptographic authentication key is absent.

title: Enforce Centralized AAA Authentication (TACACS+ / RADIUS)
description: Administrative access must require centralized AAA services (TACACS+ or RADIUS) with local fallback only in case of complete server unreachability.
rationale: Local static administrative credentials create shared credential risks and lack granular per-operator accountability.
failure_message: Centralized AAA authentication is not active. Administrative access relies exclusively on local static accounts.

title: Enforce Robust Password Policy and Strong Hash Algorithms (SHA-512 / Type 9)
description: Local accounts and enable secrets must enforce a minimum length of at least 12 characters and use modern cryptographic hashing algorithms (SHA-512 / PBKDF2 / scrypt). Legacy Type 7 (Vigenère) and Type 5 (MD5) are prohibited.
rationale: Weak passwords and obsolete hashes (Type 7 reversible cipher or MD5) can be cracked in seconds using automated tools.
failure_message: Password minimum length is below 12 characters or weak password hashing algorithm is employed.

title: Enforce Administrative Session Inactivity Timeout (<= 10 Minutes)
description: All interactive management sessions (Console, AUX, VTY, Web CLI) must automatically terminate after an inactivity period of 10 minutes (600 seconds) or less.
rationale: Unattended administrative sessions leave open terminals exposed to physical or network tampering by unauthorized personnel.
failure_message: Session inactivity timeout is either disabled (set to 0) or exceeds the 10-minute maximum limit.

title: Disable Weak Cryptographic Ciphers and Hash Suites
description: Legacy and broken cryptographic algorithms including DES, 3DES, RC4, CBC-mode ciphers in SSH, MD5, and SHA1 must be disabled across all protocol stacks.
rationale: Weak ciphers and hashing functions are vulnerable to known collision and plaintext recovery attacks.
failure_message: Weak cryptographic algorithms (such as 3DES, RC4, or MD5) are permitted in device configuration.

title: Disable Unnecessary Network Services and Small Servers
description: Legacy utility services such as finger, chargen, echo, daytime, bootp server, and CDP on external facing interfaces must be disabled.
rationale: Unnecessary services increase the attack surface and can be exploited for amplification denial of service or network reconnaissance.
failure_message: Unnecessary or legacy network services (e.g. small-servers, finger, bootp) are active.
